sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (listed on Wikimedia Commons file page)
sources.use: Near-frontal visual reference for six tall slender supports, scroll/leaf-like capitals, dentilled entablature, pediment outline and apex ornament, broad stair, red brick wings, and red clay roof tile.
sources.measurement: Rough pediment-to-facade pixel ratio was used to set the portico at about 17.9 m wide against the Archives-reported 70 m facade length. Estimated ratio is about 0.25 +/-0.04; the source is perspective imagery, not a measured elevation.
sources.limits: Trees obscure the lower facade and doors; perspective and camera framing introduce uncertainty. No dimensions or camera calibration are derived from the image. Roof pitch and exact capital/dentil dimensions are interpretive.
sources.camera_note: 34 mm perspective near-frontal view with a similar entrance-centered azimuth. Original camera pose and distance are unknown, so this is a same-view-direction comparison, not a calibrated photogrammetric match.

sources.title: Facts & Figures, Purdue Engineering Computer and Electrical Engineering
sources.provider: Purdue University College of Engineering, ECE
sources.use: Elevated campus aerial cross-check of Hovde central entrance, broad red-tiled roof, and low visible roofline. The perspective gives no reliable roof pitch, concealed ridge/hip plan, or measured dimensions.
sources.limits: Promotional aerial, oblique angle and distance obscure roof geometry; used only to confirm visible roof covering and low broad massing.

round_10_changes: Slimmed all six shafts to 0.79 m diameter while keeping their six-photo-supported layout and original heights; reduced oversize bases and capitals proportionally.
Added flared echinus and abacus blocks plus paired scroll/leaf reliefs at the six capitals, matching visible classical capital cues in the source photo. Exact carving profile remains interpretive.

Raised the entablature/frieze, added a projecting cornice, 37 small dentils, raking pediment moldings, and an apex acroterion. Pediment rise now approximately 5 m rather than the round-9 squat profile.
Added recessed stone window jambs/lintels and fine muntins on the long facades; softened brick mortar contrast and bump and kept cool blue-gray glazing.

Mapped shallow-relief terracotta tile courses on the hipped roof and added a low eave tile lip. The unsupported raised penthouse block was removed because it conflicted with the photographed continuous roof silhouette; no roof plan was located.
remaining_uncertainty: The 2016 photo and Purdue ECE aerial support a red-tile roof and low broad roofline only. Roof pitch, exact ridge and hip geometry, and hidden roof structure remain unverified; the shallow 0.16 m cap is a restrained visual approximation.
Capital foliage is supported by the visible leafy classical form in the 2016 image, but exact botanical carving, relief depth, count, and layout remain interpretive.
Portico dimensions, column spacing/projection, upper central window positions, and roof-slab footprint proxy are visual/source estimates rather than surveyed measurements.
The source/GIS overlay compares the filled GIS polygon to a roof-slab convex-hull proxy; it does not establish exact wall-to-wall polygon registration. Master placement is coordinator-owned.
round_11_changes: Shifted the complete six-column front portico assembly 1.15 m outward while keeping the door and window shell in place, creating a deeper estimated entrance recess. No campus placement/root transform changed.

Replaced prior bead-like capital relief with six restrained pointed, ribbed limestone acanthus blades per capital; the blade arrangement is a photo-informed interpretation rather than a measured carving profile.
Kept the terracotta roof silhouette/material unchanged because the available exterior image supports red tile and a low eave but not additional roof geometry.
round_12_changes: Simplified the roof mesh from a 0.90 m inferred rise to a 0.16 m shallow tiled cap. The 2016 image and SAH Archipedia support red clay tile and a low visible eave, but neither provides a roof plan or reliable hidden ridge/hip pitch; the concealed roof layout is explicitly unverified.

Warmed and refined both Indiana-limestone materials, reduced coarse procedural bump, and added fine raised midribs to six leaf blades on each of the six capitals. These reliefs are modest visual interpretations of the leafy carving visible in the 2016 entrance photo.

Realigned only the three central window assemblies on each of the upper three stories on the portico-facing facade into the open bays between the six columns. First-floor entrance glazing/doors and all side/rear windows remain fixed; the change is a photo-informed sightline correction.
round_13_changes: Added a Purdue ECE 2023 elevated campus aerial as a second roof evidence view. It confirms a broad red-tile roof and low visible roofline but cannot resolve exact pitch or concealed hips/ridge; retained the conservative 0.16 m shallow roof surface and explicitly label its plan/pitch as unverified.

Replaced faceted round-11/12 acanthus panels with six smooth, shallow leaf relief meshes per capital and subtle midrib curves. The 2016 exterior photograph supports leafy classical capitals; exact carving layout remains interpretive and no unsupported corner volutes or cross-veins were added.

Generated a source-only footprint comparison between official GIS feature 618 and the saved HOVD_Roof_Slab XY convex-hull proxy. The project local coordinate conversion includes the saved HOVD_Root parent-inverse translation. The source roof-slab proxy has raster IoU 0.8945 with GIS at 0.25 m cells, GIS coverage 0.9609, and proxy coverage 0.9282; these are proxy comparisons, not exact wall-polygon registration or master-placement certification.

Measured the GIS major-edge orientation at 39.301 degrees counter-clockwise from north and the source long axis at 39.52 degrees, a 0.219 degree difference. The root transform and master marker were not edited; coordinator separately owns the master marker verification.
